ja362:1.1: Sīlaṃ seyyo sutaṃ seyyo iti me saṃsayo ahū, sīlam eva sutā seyyo iti me n' atthi saṃsayo.
ja362:2.1: Moghā jāti ca vaṇṇo ca, sīlam eva kir' uttamaṃ, sīlena anupetassa suten' attho na vijjati.
ja362:3.1: Khattiyo ca adhammaṭṭho vesso cādhammanissito te pariccajj' ubho loke upapajjanti duggatiṃ.
ja362:4.1: Khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā caṇḍālapukkusā idha dhammaṃ caritvāna bhavanti tidive samā.
ja362:5.1: Na vedā samparāyāya na jāti no pi bandhavā sakañ ca sīlaṃ saṃsuddhaṃ samparāyasukhāya cā 'ti.
